$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema: "../guide.schema.json".

id.description: The guide's folder name and its deep link: ?guide=<id>.

licence.description: The licence of the script and narration.

credits.description: Everything the guide uses that someone made.

scene.description: The whole view at the chapter's start: where a guide seeks to. Its switches as a preset has them, or as listed.

oneOf.description: The Sun, the Moon or a planet, at the app clock's time.
A fixed place on the sky, ICRS.
A direction in the local frame: azimuth clockwise from north, altitude above the horizon. -90 is straight down.
A place on or in the Earth.

A name from the baked label files (geo/labels.json, geology.json, quakes.json). `labelKind` tells apart places that share a name: Georgia the country from Georgia the state. A name no baked file has is looked for among the names of the layers loaded: "M31". A guide may use only baked names, which can be checked before it plays.

layers.description: The switches that are on; every other is off. Empty is all off.
